idea-plugin.name: Cat Clapping
idea-plugin.description:
React to builds, runs, tests, debug sessions, and terminal commands directly inside your IDE: celebrate successes with the animated Clapping Cat and react to errors with the confused HUH Cat (with synchronized sound).

Supported triggers:

  • Run, Debug & Test configurations across PyCharm, CLion, IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, GoLand, and other IntelliJ-based IDEs (Clapping Cat on exit code 0; HUH Cat on failures, ignoring manual Ctrl+C / Stop cancellations).
  • IDE Builds (e.g. CMake, Make, Gradle, Maven) on build success or failure.
  • Integrated Terminal commands via shell integration (new Terminal), including Python (python, pytest, uv run, poetry run), C/C++ (gcc, cc, clang, g++, clang++, cl.exe, cmake, make, ninja, and compiled executables on macOS, Linux, and Windows), Node.js, Rust, Go, .NET, and Java.

Both reactions are enabled by default and can be toggled or configured independently (commands, sound, volume, size, screen position, and preview) under Settings → Tools → Cat Clapping.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.0

  • Added the animated HUH Cat error reaction (with timed HUH caption and synchronized sound) for failed Run/Debug/Test sessions, failed IDE builds, and failing terminal commands, ignoring manual Ctrl+C / Stop cancellations.
  • Added independent enable/disable toggles (both enabled by default) and separate tabs (Clapping Cat (Success) and HUH Cat (Error)) in Settings → Tools → Cat Clapping with per-reaction commands, custom commands, sound/volume, size, draggable position preview, and test buttons.
  • Added selectable HUH clip mode (2nd HUH only (Default), 1st HUH only, or Full (both HUHs)) with synchronized GIF and audio slicing.

0.1.8

  • Added selectable supported commands and custom terminal commands in Settings → Tools → Cat Clapping.
  • Added a draggable IDE window preview and anchor selector (IDE Window or Active Editor) to position the cat overlay freely, and increased the default cat size.
  • Hardened overlay/audio lifecycle, non-blocking settings preview loading, and terminal listener cleanup.

0.1.7

  • Fixed EDT threading violation during project startup by dispatching startup hook registration via invokeLater.

0.1.6

  • Terminal integration now uses only the public Terminal API (IDE 2025.3+); removed internal Block Terminal APIs.
  • Startup listeners migrated to ProjectActivity.
  • Minimum supported IDE version is now 2025.3.

0.1.5

  • Synchronized cat GIF frames directly to audio playback time using a custom frame-by-frame GIF decoder (CatAnimation).
  • Pre-warms audio and initial frames in the background so visual animation and sound start together.
  • Improved HiDPI/Retina rendering sharpness for the cat overlay.

0.1.4

  • Fixed Java Sound playback closing early before audio finished playing.
  • Added configurable cat overlay size and audio volume sliders in Settings → Tools → Cat Clapping.
  • Increased default cat overlay height for better visibility.

0.1.3

  • Added 40x40 SVG plugin icon and JetBrains Marketplace metadata.
  • Supports Run/Debug/Test, BuildView, and Terminal shell-integration triggers (Python, uv, and C/C++ across macOS, Linux, and Windows).
